label: Zone 2-3 - the paint-protecting shell
definition: Two defenders across the top, three along the bottom. The 2-3 protects the rim and the defensive glass, concedes the above-the-break three, and dares the offence to beat it with passing, patience and shot-making. Its structure is a set of area assignments plus three movement rules: move on the flight of the ball, touch the midline, bump and release cutters.

key: Move on the flight of the ball: the shell slides with every pass, not after it
Touch the midline: weak-side back-line defenders must be in help position on the split line
Bump cutters as they pass through your area, then release them to the next defender
The top two 'match' the ball and take away the middle
Rebounding is the zone's structural weakness: everyone must find a body
The free-throw line is 'the hole': a catch there splits the bottom three

nodes.label: Zone 2-3 Defence
nodes.definition: A five-man area defence organised as two perimeter defenders over three back-line defenders.

nodes.label: Top-left guard
nodes.definition: The left of the two top defenders. Meets the ball at the top, matches to the ball side, and takes away the middle drive.

nodes.label: Top-right guard
nodes.definition: The right of the two top defenders. Mirrors the left, sinks towards the free-throw line when the ball is on the strong side, and sprints to the new ball side on a reversal.

nodes.label: Bottom-left (forward)
nodes.definition: The left of the three back-line defenders. Guards the left short corner and the left corner three, and must touch the midline of the lane when the ball is on the weak side.

nodes.label: Bottom-middle (anchor)
nodes.definition: The middle of the three back-line defenders. Owns the paint and the restricted area, steps up to the high post when the ball goes there, and is the last line at the rim.

key: Must step to the free-throw line: the hole is his responsibility
Cannot camp in the lane: the defensive three-second rule still applies

nodes.label: Bottom-right (forward)
nodes.definition: The right of the three back-line defenders. Guards the right short corner and the right corner three, and must touch the midline of the lane when the ball is on the weak side.

nodes.label: Set the shell
nodes.definition: Two defenders at the level of the top of the key, three across the bottom of the lane; every defender in his area, hands in the passing lanes, feet in a stance.

key: The shell must be visible: hands up, five sets of eyes on the ball
The bottom three align to the ball, not to the baseline

nodes.label: Top defenders match the ball
nodes.definition: The top two slide with the ball: the ball-side top defender meets it above the break, the weak-side top defender sinks to the free-throw line extended to take away the middle pass.

key: No middle: force the ball to the sideline where the shell has help
The top two must communicate the pass-off on every swing

nodes.label: Bottom three align to the ball
nodes.definition: The back line slides with the ball: ball-side bottom man to the short corner, middle man to the split line on the ball side, weak-side bottom man on the midline of the lane.

key: Align to the ball, then to the baseline
Never let the ball-side corner man get isolated against two offensive players

nodes.label: Touch the midline
nodes.definition: The weak-side back-line defender keeps a foot on or past the midline of the lane, so that he is in help position the instant the ball is reversed.

key: A foot on the line, not a body in the lane
The midline is the difference between a rotation and a scramble

nodes.label: Bump the cutter, then release him
nodes.definition: When an offensive player cuts through your area, displace him for a beat to break the timing, then hand him to the next area's defender.

key: A bump is momentary: displace, do not hold
Communication is the mechanism: 'bump, bump, release'

nodes.label: Rotate on the flight of the ball
nodes.definition: Every pass moves the shell one step: defenders slide on the flight, not after the catch, and the last man to move closes out under control.

key: Move when the ball is in the air
The closeout must be controlled: chop, hand up, no fly-bys

nodes.label: Answer the ball reversal
nodes.definition: On a top-to-wing-to-top reversal the top defenders sprint to the new ball side and the bottom three slide across; this second shift is where the zone is most vulnerable, so the bottom men must sprint the width of the lane.

key: The second shift is the kill: sprint it or concede the corner three
Do not watch the ball: move with it

nodes.label: Find a body and box out
nodes.definition: As soon as a shot goes up, every defender finds the nearest offensive player, makes contact and goes for the ball. The zone's structural weakness ends here.

key: Area defence means nobody owns a man: that is the weakness on the glass
The bottom three must be the first to a body, not the first to the ball
